newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Feb inflation steady, past revised.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Feb inflation steady, past revised.

text.p: The Melbourne Institute's measure of Australian consumers inflationary expectations edged up to 3.7 percent in February from a downward revised 3.6 percent in January.
The Institute said due to a new method of calculating the median all past readings had been revised down, January's from an original 4.1 percent.

"Consumer inflationary expectations remain stubbornly high," said the institute. "It appears consumers are still hesitant about lowering inflationary expectations, even in light of falls in measured inflation."
Consumer price inflation fell to an annual 1.5 percent in the December quarter from 1.9 percent, while underlying inflation slowed to 2.1 percent from 2.3 percent.
